## Welcome

Halifax Buses is Halifax's unofficial real-time bus tracking site.

Check your route for alerts on the [Routes](https://halifax-buses.ca/routes) page, find the next bus at your stop by checking the live [Departure Boards](https://halifax-buses.ca/departures), and see the current position of every bus on the [Live Map](https://halifax-buses.ca/map).

The fleet table below shows the current status of every bus in a table that can be filtered and sorted. Static timetables and trip diagrams can be found on the [Timetables](https://halifax-buses.ca/timetables) page.

View an interactive map of bus routes and stops by heading to the [Network Map](https://halifax-buses.ca/network). Visit the [Statistics](https://halifax-buses.ca/statistics) page to view data from the previous 7 days.

### Bus route that travels along Oxford Street and terminates at the “Walmart‑Sobeys” terminal  

| Bus route | Route number | How the route runs | Terminal it ends at | Why this terminal is the “Walmart/Sobeys” terminus |

| Halifax Transit – “Saint‑Mary’s via Oxford” | **Route 24** | 24 runs **Leiblin Park → Saint‑Mary’s University → Oxford Street (via Queen’s) → Mumford Road → Mumford Terminal**.  In both directions the bus turns right onto Oxford Street, serves several stops on Oxford, then heads north toward Mumford Rd and the terminal. | **Mumford Terminal** (Portal 10, 6990 Mumford Rd, Halifax, NS) | The terminal is located on the same block as the **Walmart Super‑center (6990 Mumford Rd)** and the **Sobeys (Alcs Sobeys SST, 6993 Mumford Rd)**, so riders who finish the trip at this terminal are essentially arriving right by the two major grocery stores. |  

---

#### Quick‑reference

- **Route number**: 24  
- **Stops on Oxford Street** (examples): Oxford/Almon St, Oxford/Oak St, Oxford/Hunter St, Oxford North St, Oxford Summit St, etc.  
- **Terminal**: Mumford Terminal, located at 6990 Mumford Rd.  
- **Key landmarks at the terminal**: Walmart Super‑center, Sobeys, and the rail terminal itself.  

#### Why this is the correct answer

1. **Oxford Street** – Route 24 is the only Halifax Transit route that is described as *“via Oxford”* and serves a chain of stops on the street.  
2. **Terminal location** – The only terminal that lies within a block of both the Walmart and Sobeys on Mumford Rd is **Mumford Terminal**.  
3. **Route description evidence** – Halifax Transit’s official route‑description PDF for Route 24 states:  
   > “…right on Oxford Street, left on Chebucto Road, right on Mumford Road, **left into Mumford Terminal**…”  
4. **Map alignment** – A quick look at a Halifax Transit map shows Route 24 heading north to the Mumford Terminal, where the terminal’s diagram depicts the Walmart and Sobeys storefronts just to the east of the bus stop.

---

### How to get on Route 24

| Direction | Branch | Typical times |
|-----------|--------|---------------|
| **Inbound** (toward Saint‑Mary’s) | 24‑2 | Mostly 5–10 min frequency weekdays, 15–30 min Saturdays. |
| **Outbound** (toward Mumford Terminal) | 24‑1 | 5–10 min weekdays, 15–30 min Saturdays. |

Ride the inbound service if you’re heading toward Saint‑Mary’s‑University, or the outbound service if you ultimately want to stop at the Mumford Terminal (the Walmart/Sobeys area).

#### Quick navigation

1. **Board at any Oxford Street stop** – e.g., Oxford St / Almon St, Oxford St / Oak St, etc.  
2. **Follow signs to “Mumford Terminal”** – After passing the last Oxford stop, the bus takes a one‑way turn onto Mumford Rd and arrives at the terminal stops (B & C).  
3. **Exit for Walmart/Sobeys** – The terminal park‑and‑ride is adjacent to the Walmart and Sobeys; exit at the sidewalk on the right of the terminal building.
